data.overview: Beauty Coiffure is a French e-commerce retailer of hairdressing and beauty products based in Chalon-sur-Saône, selling third-party brands such as OPI, Umberto Giannini and ghd rather than manufacturing its own line. Independent review platforms show strong customer satisfaction, with a 4.6 TrustScore across 3,175 Trustpilot reviews and a 4.6 Google store rating across over 73,000 reviews, praising delivery speed, pricing and product range. No brand-specific evidence on safety, sustainability, cruelty-free, vegan or labour practices was found in the fetched sources.

papers.title: Beauty Coiffure Reviews | 2 of 4 - Trustpilot
papers.summary: Beauty Coiffure, a French e-commerce retailer of hairdressing and beauty products based in Chalon-sur-Saône, holds a TrustScore of 4.6 from over 3,175 Trustpilot reviews. Reviewers praise product availability, quick delivery, attractive prices, and product range, though Trustpilot notes the company has not replied to negative reviews.

findings.text: The brand holds a high aggregate customer rating on Trustpilot across a large review base.
Reviewers report satisfaction with ease of navigation, product availability and pricing.
findings.quote:
Very satisfied.

findings.text: Customers highlight fast delivery and a product range not easily found elsewhere.
findings.quote: Everything was good! The delivery was really quick and the website has a lot of products that I can't easily find elsewhere.

findings.text: Trustpilot flags that the company has not responded to negative reviews.

papers.title: Beauty Coiffure - Google
papers.summary: Google's store page for Beauty Coiffure shows a 4.6 store rating from over 73,000 reviews and describes the retailer's social media promotion of third-party brands such as OPI, Umberto Giannini and ghd. The data reflects an e-commerce shopping experience rather than the brand's own manufactured products.

findings.text: Beauty Coiffure carries a high Google store rating across a very large review base.
The retailer promotes and sells third-party professional brands including OPI and ghd.
